ai-memory.headersHelper: TOKEN_FILE="${AI_MEMORY_TOKEN_FILE:-${HOME}/.local/share/opencode/secrets/aimemory-token}"; T=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$TOKEN_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$T" ] || exit 0; T_JSON=$(printf '%s' "$T" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g'); printf '{"Authorization":"Bearer %s"}' "$T_JSON"
